The prediction was stark: artificial intelligence advancements would wipe out jobs en masse. “Half” of all entry-level white collar jobs would vanish, Anthropic’s CEO, Dario Amodei, said in May 2025.

articles.title: Agent context layers: Enterprises governing their AI data are catching twice as many bad answers as the ones who aren't
